recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中的顆粒（particle）以脂肪空泡與淡粉紅色基質為主，只夾雜稀疏的深染細胞，周圍全是紅血球背景，看不到成群的造血細胞，提示治療後骨髓低細胞性。
features: Single marrow particle composed predominantly of fat vacuoles and stromal meshwork
Sparse hematopoietic cells scattered within the particle
Dark-staining stromal and endothelial nuclei forming a network
Small refractile golden-brown deposits consistent with hemosiderin
Background of peripheral blood red cells with very few nucleated cells
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed largely of fat vacuoles and stromal elements with only sparse hematopoietic cells. Scattered golden-brown pigment consistent with hemosiderin is present. The trails and background consist mostly of red cells with very few nucleated marrow elements. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular marrow, in keeping with post-therapy aplasia; cellularity should be confirmed on the trephine biopsy.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a similarly fatty, stroma-rich marrow, so distinction depends on clinical history of therapy and exclusion of other causes rather than aspirate morphology.
A hemodiluted aspirate lacks marrow particles, whereas here the particle itself is fatty and hypocellular; biopsy cellularity is the definitive measure.
Hypoplastic myeloid neoplasms retain dysplastic or blast populations and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, which need to be sought on cellular areas and ancillary studies.
